items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: I found Damita Jo, and I did an album on Damita Jo.

ctx.x: That's right. And so I started Melic record label, and I had 2 publishing companies; one in BMI called Flipside and the other in ASCAP called Land Lee. Well, I recorded some people.

You know, speaking of Ethel Waters, I thought -- my thing about looking for Ethel Waters at the time, I thought it would be a good idea, because I'll tell you, my first time away from home, I went away from home with here, and I thought in my mind it would be a good thing to get here and record her. But after I -- I did find her in Pasadena, incidentally -- after I went out and talked to her, then I began to learn a little more about the record business, and I knew it would not be a good idea to record her, so…
She sang at the Oasis when your band was there, didn't she?
